Zevlor is the leader of a group of Tiefling refugees who are traveling to Baldur's Gate after being exiled from their home. He and his fellow tieflings are found hiding within the Emerald Grove.
“
We'd need an army of our own to escort us safely to Baldur's Gate, and while I don't doubt your abilities... you're no army.
„
— Zevlor in the Emerald Grove

Background

Zevlor was a Commander of the Hellriders of Elturel. After the Fall of Elturel, many people started viewing tieflings with distrust thinking their race was to blame for it. Due to this, Zevlor was forced to leave his position and abandon the city, taking a group of tieflings with him in the hopes for a better life at Baldur's Gate.

Involvement

Act One

Zevlor is first encountered during the initial Goblin assault at the Emerald Grove. He defends the Grove against the attack together with some tieflings as well as  Aradin, and  Wyll.

If the party speak with Zevlor after the skirmish, he requests the party's aid in dealing with  Kagha and the Goblin leaders. If they agree to help him and are successful in stopping her, he rewards the party with his enchanted gloves, Hellrider's Pride.

If the party side with the tieflings against  Minthara and the forces of the Absolute and Zevlor survives, he is extremely grateful, and prepares a surprise celebration at the Campsite with the rest of the refugees, before leading them to the city. After this, he bids them farewell with hopes of encountering the party again.

If the party side with Minthara and the rest of the goblins instead, he furiously calls the player character a traitor, and takes up arms to defend his people.

If Zevlor dies while siding with the tiefling refugees,  Asharak replaces him as the refugees' leader. If Asharak is also dead or otherwise unavailable,  Cerys replaces Zevlor. In this scenario, Cerys only appears after the Goblin Leaders are defeated.

Travelling to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving Kagha's Rite of Thorns, results in the expulsion of all the tiefling refugees from the Emerald Grove; Zevlor's corpse is then among the bodies of all the other refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village.

Act Two

Main article: Find Zevlor

If Zevlor survives Act One, he and the other refugees make their way through the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

By speaking with the surviving tieflings at the Last Light Inn, the party can find out that the refugees were attacked and Zevlor tried to surrender. He was then captured along with several other tieflings. This initiates the quest ⁠Find Zevlor.

Zevlor can later be found in a transformation pod within the Mind Flayer Colony. He can be released by opening all pods, which initiates combat with several  Mind Flayers. If Zevlor survives, he tells the party how the Absolute infiltrated his mind, causing him to call out the surrender during the attack on the refugees. He believes that the other tieflings will not welcome him back and cannot be convinced otherwise, ultimately leaving on his own. He can otherwise be purged along with all the mind flayers, killing him.

Act Three

If Zevlor is not killed or released at the Mind Flayer Colony,  Orin the Red kills him instead and leaves his corpse along with a  Grand Infernal Painting at the campsite. Communing with his corpse reveals he was used as an offering and that Orin is located below the city.

Otherwise, if he is saved from the pod in the Mind Flayer Colony, his  Hellrider Platoon can be summoned as allies using the  Call Forth Allies Class Action while ascending towards the  Netherbrain at High Hall. However, he along with the  Armored Owlbear, are two major characters who can permanently die during this final fight. If Zevlor dies, he is removed from the Epilogue.

Epilogue

If Zevlor survives the Netherbrain fight, a thank-you note from him is in the  Chest of Grateful Words. In his note he reveals the Hellriders now have no oath but have nevertheless taken up residence in Baldur's Gate to protect the city from suffering as they did in Elturel.

Companion approval

Upon entering the Emerald Grove,  Aradin and Zevlor argue about the missing Druid  Halsin and the pack of Goblins that Aradin brought.

If a party member intervenes in their argument, companion approval is gained or lost on successful checks:

  • [PERSUASION] More violence won't bring back those you lost. Stop and think. (DC 15)
  • [TIEFLING] He's human - malice comes as naturally as breathing. Just show him you're the better man. (DC N/A)
  • [INTIMIDATION] If you want me to take both of you down, I will. Otherwise, knock it off. (DC 10)
  • [OATH OF THE CROWN] [INTIMIDATION] You are leaders - stop bickering like spoilt children. (DC 5 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] STOP OR I'LL BASH YOUR SKULLS TOGETHER MYSELF. (DC 5 )
  • [HALF-ORC] [INTIMIDATION] Want me to knock you both out? Or would you prefer to skip the broken bones and just calm down? (DC 5)

Any of the above:  +8  +1  +1  +1

  • Stand back and watch.  +1
  • [STRENGTH] Take a swing at the tiefling. (DC 17)  -1  +1  -1
  • [STRENGTH] Aim a blow at the human, trying to knock him flat on his back. (DC 15)  +1  +1  +1

After the argument between  Aradin and Zevlor, the party can offer to speak with  Kagha.

  • I'll see what I can do.  -1  +1  +1  -1  +5
  • I'm sorry. I've got my own problems.  -1  +1  +1  -1

If the party resolve the conflict with Kagha but the Goblin leaders remain, they can offer to infiltrate the Goblin Camp.

  • Kill the goblin horde's leaders? I'll see what I can do.  -1  +1  +5  +5

Speak with Dead

Zevlor can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

If killed during raid on grove:

  • Who are you?
    • Zevlor
      Zevlor... Hellrider... but cast out...
  • Where are you from?
    • Zevlor
      Elturel... city on the river... terrible times...
      • What happened in Elturel?
        • Zevlor
          Dragged... to the Hells. They blamed... us. Fools.
  • What should the tieflings do now that you're dead?
    • Zevlor
      Finish... the plan. Go... where... they belong...
  • Did you have any secrets?
    • Zevlor
      Plenty... to have... none... to tell...

If killed in the Tadpoling Centre:

  • What happened to you?
    • Zevlor
      Blessed... by the Chosen...
      • Where are these Chosen now?
        • Zevlor
          Down... in the dark... down... down...
  • Who put you in that pod?
    • Zevlor
      The Absolute's... Chosen... an offering...
      • Where are these Chosen now?
        • Zevlor
          Down... in the dark... down... down...
  • Why did you surrender your people to the cult?
    • Zevlor
      Her voice... Absolute... promised...
      • What happened after you surrendered?
        • Zevlor
          Moonrise... granted audience... the others...
          • Zevlor
            What... happened to... others...?
      • What did the voice of the Absolute promise you?
        • Zevlor
          To be... paladin again... protect... my people...
          • Zevlor
            My... people... where are... my people...?
      • Many of your people died. Because of you.
        • Zevlor
          No... we are... sainted... safe... home...

Notes

  • Although Zevlor is a Tiefling, he does not have  Darkvision.
  • If the player character persists in telling Zevlor to vacate the grove per Kagha's request, he initiates a fight against the party. If Zevlor is killed, then the party cannot participate in the goblin raid of the grove; Minthara tells the party to infiltrate and attack at first light, but the grove will spawn in a post-raided state the following morning.
